description: Zadig: installs a generic USB driver (WinUSB, libusb-win32/libusb0, libusbK or USB serial) for a chosen USB device, so libusb programs (MTKClient, fastboot tools, SDR software) can open it.
notes: Zadig asks for admin rights (UAC) every time it starts.
Options > List All Devices shows devices that already have a driver. Replacing the driver of a keyboard, mouse,
hub or storage device can make it stop working; undo in Device Manager > the device > Driver > Roll Back Driver
or Uninstall device (with 'Attempt to remove the driver').
Zadig reads zadig.ini (defaults: advanced mode, driver, list all devices) from the folder it is started in:
the Zadig shortcut in 'Scoop Apps' starts it in its app folder, where zadig.ini is persisted (empty = defaults).
